summary: Practise BATNA, ZOPA, de-escalation, and service recovery planning. Explore the five-day course and strengthen support conversations.
lede: Negotiation skills help support professionals agree workable service outcomes within policy and authority limits. Customer support, service desk, and customer success teams practise preparing a BATNA, mapping interests, assessing agreement ranges, and setting concession limits. They also practise escalation choices and documenting clear resolution terms in case notes for refunds, delays, and disputed expectations.
audienceIntro: This course suits professionals who negotiate service outcomes with customers or colleagues while working within support policies, escalation routes, and limited authority.
prerequisites: Familiarity with customer support, service desk, or client-service workflows is expected. No prior negotiation qualification is required. No coding or programming is required.
